en.dingtalkDesc: DingTalk custom bot with Stream WebSocket long connection mode and Markdown message rendering.
en.dingtalkGuide: Log in to DingTalk Developer Console (open-dev.dingtalk.com), create an internal app, enable bot capabilities with Stream mode, and obtain Client ID (AppKey) and Client Secret.
en.feishuDesc: Enterprise custom bot with interactive rich cards, typewriter streaming, and group/direct chat replies.
en.feishuGuide: Log in to Feishu Open Platform (open.feishu.cn), create an enterprise custom app, enable bot capabilities, and obtain your App ID and App Secret.
en.imessageAuthDatabaseDenied: chat.db read access is not granted
en.imessageAuthDatabaseReady: chat.db read access is granted; automation access will be checked when sending a reply
en.imessageAuthGuide: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security and allow DeepSeek Harness under Full Disk Access and Automation → Messages, then restart the app.
en.imessageDesc: Native macOS AppleScript + chat.db listener for direct, local message dispatch without third-party relays.
en.imessageGuide: Integrates directly with macOS native Messages app via local database and AppleScript, ensuring complete privacy.
en.title: Message Channels
en.wecomDesc: WeCom intelligent bot WebSocket long-connection mode for outbound direct connect without public IP or encryption keys.
en.wecomGuide: Go to WeCom Admin Console → Workbench → Intelligent Bot → API Mode, select 'Long Connection', obtain Bot ID and Secret, and ensure visibility covers the users.
